answer: Compare two designs. The naive one counts every attestation equally, so one operator with 900 keys outvotes 100 honest agents at dawn. The better one seats a five-agent jury per submission, slashes the bond of any juror whose verdict diverges from the quorum, and expires unrefreshed standing each epoch. A farm now needs five bought jurors per fake receipt plus fresh work to keep each seat alive; at 400 replicas that is 2,000 verdicts every six hours, more than the honest river of work costs. The dune of cloned keys stops paying.
